assertions.assertion: The denial carries reason code PR-204.
CPT 93247 represents long-term continuous ECG monitoring.
The claim pertains to episode ep-05147.

The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and a significant history of transient ischemic attacks.
The submitted diagnosis codes are I48.0, G45.9, and Z86.73.

The note states that, given the concern for intermittent arrhythmia contributing to cerebral hypoperfusion, long-term continuous ECG monitoring is ordered to correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances.
The denial was a coverage determination (service not covered under the member's benefit plan) subject to reconsideration/appeal.
